description_good_justification: README.md opens with a concise description and explains the problem, workflow, and trust boundaries.
interact_justification: README.md documents installation and CLI use; CONTRIBUTING.md and .github/SUPPORT.md document feedback channels.
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents setup, topic branches, quality gates, pull requests, and issue templates.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md defines Ruff, pytest, formatting, regression-test, scope, review, and commit-message requirements.
license_location_justification: The full license is in LICENSE at the repository root and linked from README.md.
documentation_basics_justification: README.md covers installation, commands, architecture, configuration, data, limitations, and related work.
documentation_interface_justification: README.md documents the CLI commands and flags; docs/ provides supporting design material.
sites_https_justification: The public project and its support links use HTTPS GitHub endpoints.
discussion_justification: Public GitHub Issues provide a URL-addressable, searchable discussion and support channel.
english_justification: Project documentation, templates, and code comments are in English.
maintained_justification: The main branch and dependency automation show current maintenance activity.
repo_public_justification: The source repository is publicly readable at https://github.com/dcondrey/blindmind.
repo_track_justification: Git records authorship, timestamps, messages, and diffs for project changes.
repo_interim_justification: The Git history contains incremental feature, fix, test, documentation, and maintenance commits.
repo_distributed_justification: The project uses Git, a distributed version-control system.
version_unique_justification: pyproject.toml declares the SemVer-compatible package version 0.1.0.
version_semver_justification: The declared 0.1.0 version follows Semantic Versioning syntax.
version_tags_justification: No release tags have been created yet.
release_notes_justification: No tagged release exists yet; CHANGELOG.md tracks unreleased changes.
release_notes_vulns_justification: There are no release notes to evaluate before the first tagged release.
report_process_justification: Structured bug and feature templates live in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE and are linked from CONTRIBUTING.md.
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues is the public per-item report tracker.
report_responses_justification: Response-time performance requires a longer history of independently submitted reports.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement response-time performance requires a longer request history.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues provides a public, searchable archive of reports and responses.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md documents private advisory and email reporting, requested evidence, and coordinated disclosure.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md links directly to GitHub private security advisories and provides a security email.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability-report response record is available to assess.
build_justification: pyproject.toml defines a standard setuptools build and the Makefile/README document installation with uv.
build_common_tools_justification: The project uses standard Python packaging, uv, setuptools, and Make.
build_floss_tools_justification: The required build toolchain and declared build dependencies are FLOSS.
test_justification: The repository includes automated pytest coverage for the CLI, engines, persistence, settings, and interoperability.
test_invocation_justification: Tests run with the documented standard command uv run pytest -v or make test.
test_most_justification: The suite is broad, but no enforced project-wide coverage threshold establishes majority coverage.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs Ruff and pytest on every pull request and push to main across Python 3.11-3.13.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md asks for a regression test for each fix or new behavior where feasible.
tests_are_added_justification: The maintained tests/ suite includes regression tests alongside current functionality.
tests_documented_added_justification: The test-addition expectation is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md.
warnings_justification: Ruff lint and formatting checks run locally and in CI.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails when Ruff reports a lint or formatting violation.
warnings_strict_justification: Ruff enables E, F, W, I, B, UP, and S rules with a short documented exception list.
know_secure_design_justification: SECURITY.md and README.md document secret handling, local persistence, provider boundaries, and supply-chain controls.
know_common_errors_justification: Ruff security rules, typed settings, input validation, and documented key-handling rules address relevant common errors.
crypto_published_justification: BlindMind does not implement cryptographic primitives.
crypto_call_justification: The project does not expose a project-owned cryptographic API.
crypto_floss_justification: No project-owned cryptographic implementation is present.
crypto_keylength_justification: The project does not select or configure cryptographic key lengths.
crypto_working_justification: The project does not implement cryptographic algorithms.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The project does not implement or choose cryptographic algorithms.
crypto_pfs_justification: Network transport security is delegated to provider HTTPS stacks.
crypto_password_storage_justification: BlindMind has no user-account password store.
crypto_random_justification: The project does not generate cryptographic keys or nonces.
delivery_mitm_justification: Source and dependencies are delivered over authenticated SSH or HTTPS transports.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No plain-HTTP, hash-only software delivery path is documented or used.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: A public history sufficient to measure medium-severity remediation time is not yet available.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical-vulnerability remediation history is available to assess.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Secrets are loaded from environment settings; secret files are ignored and SECURITY.md forbids committing keys or logs containing them.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL and Ruff run automatically on the repository.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL and Ruff's security rules cover common Python vulnerability classes.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Ruff findings fail CI, and CodeQL is a required visible security signal on changes.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs on pushes and pull requests, with CodeQL also scheduled.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No dedicated dynamic security-analysis or fuzzing workflow is configured.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The Python project does not contain C or C++ memory-unsafe implementation code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No dedicated dynamic-analysis build exists to configure with extra assertions.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic security-analysis findings exist because no such tool is configured.
